style: Friendly children's picture-book illustration in a modern flat style: soft rounded shapes, gentle shading, clean lines, warm desert palette (sand, soft yellow, teal, coral), simple uncluttered composition, kind expressions. IMPORTANT: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words, signs with writing or logos anywhere in the image.

templates.vocab: {style} Subject: {subject}. Show only this subject, large, centered and easy to recognise, on a plain very light warm-beige background with nothing else.
templates.scene: {style} A wide scene: {subject} Match the characters exactly to the reference image (same faces, hair, skin and clothes) and keep the same illustration style.
templates.person: {style} A friendly head-and-shoulders portrait of {subject}, looking at the viewer, centered, on a plain soft light-teal background. Keep the same illustration style as the reference image.
templates.sheet: {style} Character sheet: five characters standing side by side in a row, full body, front view, same scale, evenly spaced, on a plain very light background: {subject}
